title: Welded plate box
summary: a box, a cube or a beam, cut and welded straight
description: A rectangular box, cube or beam of laser-cut steel plate from 3 mm up, to build machines from: short recessed tabs, a half-lapped egg-crate of ribs inside, and openings that follow each wall. Tab and slot from the laser hold it straight while it is welded.

difficulty.rationale: Coupled formulas, ribs re-oriented by the shortest side, cross-body checks and kernel limits.

standards: EN 1993-1-8 §4.5.2(2): smallest fillet throat 3 mm (read in IDEA StatiCa's code-check article)
AISC Table J2.3: minimum effective throat 3 mm for plate to 6 mm (read in a summary at steelcalculator.app)
